Third stacked change pushed: 2402 (magnesian-subjective-ocelot / parity guard). Implementer built parity.py cleanly (1 attempt) after the ticket's plan finally passed review-plan on round 7. Restored the full held-out test suite (10 tests) - 2 of MY OWN happy-path/edge tests were wrong (assumed ambient load_class_slots() would read the real project rebar.toml, but tests/conftest.py globally sandboxes REBAR_ROOT for safety) - fixed by using explicit fixture repo roots instead of ambient resolution. During the real integration run (regenerating the corpus manifest for the new ran_model field), found and fixed 2 more real bugs: (1) data.get("provider_provenance", {}) returns None not {} when the key exists with explicit null value (real shape in the live corpus - some sidecars have provider_provenance:null) causing AttributeError; (2) added a regression test + mutation-verified both fixes. All 20 tests in tests/unit/evals/ pass, make lint + make typecheck clean. Manifest regenerated: row_count 6400 (grew from 6378 since celestine's build - other agents landing more reviews), verified_ratio 13.4%, content_hash b17e50f8....

Status of the 3 pushed changes: 2396 (xenarthra) LLM-Review+1, Verified pending. 2398 (celestine) both pending re-review after restack. 2402 (parity) just pushed, no votes yet. Once all 3 are green (Verified+1 + LLM-Review+1), will close xenarthra + celestine + parity tickets and continue to labels/ledger (both blocked on xenarthra/celestine closing, per the fast-fail dependency check).
